menuDescription: Software updates, version info, and branch management

controls.title: BluePilot Version
controls.desc: Current BluePilot version installed on this device

controls.title: Updater State
controls.desc: Current state of the update system

controls.title: Check for Updates
controls.desc: Check for available software updates. Updates are only downloaded while the car is off.
controls.device_only_message: Update checking must be done on the device. The updater will automatically check for updates when the car is off.

controls.title: Disable Updates
controls.desc: When enabled, automatic software updates will be disabled. Requires a reboot to take effect.
controls.confirm_text:
Changing this setting requires a reboot to take effect.

Are you sure you want to change this setting?

enableConditions.reason: Cannot change update settings while driving

controls.title: Select Update Branch
controls.desc: Choose which branch to receive updates from
controls.device_only_message: Branch selection must be done on the device UI.

controls.title: Force Branch Update
controls.desc: Force update to a specific branch. This clones a fresh copy and replaces the current installation.
controls.device_only_message: Force update must be initiated from the device UI for safety.

controls.title: Uninstall BluePilot
controls.desc: Completely remove BluePilot from this device
controls.confirm_text:
Are you sure you want to uninstall BluePilot?

This will completely remove the software from your device. You will need to reinstall to use BluePilot again.
